description: This file defines the 'database' class which is a wrapper for the ADODB database abstraction layer. It manages database connections, executes queries, fetches data in various formats, and provides methods for database management specific to the TestLink project. It includes methods for handling different database types such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MSSQL, and also contains configuration and utility functions related to database operations.

classes.name: database
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing database connections, executing queries, and retrieving data using ADODB within the TestLink project.

methods.name: microtime_float
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp as a float with microsecond precision.

methods.name: setLogEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables query logging.

methods.name: getLogEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether query logging is enabled.

methods.name: setLogQueries
methods.description: Enables or disables logging of executed queries.

methods.name: getLogQueries
methods.description: Returns whether query logging is enabled.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection object based on the specified database type.

methods.name: get_dbmgr_object
methods.description: Returns the underlying ADODB connection object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using DSN or separate parameters.

methods.name: exec_query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with optional limit and offset, handles errors, and logs execution details.

methods.name: fetch_array
methods.description: Fetches a row from the result set as an associative array, handling driver-specific differences.

methods.name: db_result
methods.description: Returns a specific value from a result set, or a scalar from a query.

methods.name: insert_id
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID, with support for PostgreSQL and Oracle sequences.

methods.name: db_is_pgsql
methods.description: Checks if the current database type is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: db_is_oracle
methods.description: Checks if the current database type is Oracle.

methods.name: db_table_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the database.

methods.name: db_field_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific field exists in a given table.

methods.name: key_exists_on_field
methods.description: Checks if a specific index exists on a table field (MySQL-specific).

methods.name: prepare_string
methods.description: Sanitizes a string before database insertion.

methods.name: prepare_int
methods.description: Prepares an integer value for database insertion.

methods.name: prepare_bool
methods.description: Prepares a boolean value for database insertion.

methods.name: db_now
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp formatted for the database.

methods.name: db_timestamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp for a given date or current time.

methods.name: db_unixtimestamp
methods.description: Returns a Unix timestamp for a given date or current time.

methods.name: count_queries
methods.description: Returns the total number of executed queries.

methods.name: count_unique_queries
methods.description: Returns the count of unique queries executed.

methods.name: time_queries
methods.description: Returns the total time spent executing queries.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: error_num
methods.description: Returns the last error number from the database.

methods.name: error_msg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the database.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns a detailed error message including error code and message, optionally with the query.

methods.name: num_rows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a result set.

methods.name: affected_rows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: fetchFirstRowSingleColumn
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the first column of the first row.

methods.name: fetchFirstRow
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the first row as an associative array.

methods.name: fetchOneValue
methods.description: Returns a single value from the query result.

methods.name: fetchColumnsIntoArray
methods.description: Fetches all values of a specific column into an array.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap
methods.description: Fetches rows into an associative map keyed by a specific column.

methods.name: build_sql_create_db
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating databases in various DBMS.

methods.name: db_null_timestamp
methods.description: Returns a null timestamp value appropriate for the DBMS.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap2l
methods.description: Fetches rows into a 2-level nested map keyed by two columns.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap3l
methods.description: Fetches rows into a 3-level nested map keyed by three columns.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap4l
methods.description: Fetches rows into a 4-level nested map keyed by four columns.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMapAddRC
methods.description: Fetches rows into a map with an added record count per key.

methods.name: fetchMapRowsIntoMapStackOnCol
methods.description: Fetches rows into a nested map with stacked values for a specific column.

methods.name: fetchMapRowsIntoMap
methods.description: Fetches two-column data into a map with keys and values specified.

methods.name: get_version_info
methods.description: Returns server version and description info.

methods.name: get_recordset
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all rows as an array.

methods.name: fetchArrayRowsIntoMap
methods.description: Fetches multiple rows into a map keyed by a specific column.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap2l
methods.description: Fetches rows into a nested map of two levels based on two key columns.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap3l
methods.description: Fetches rows into a nested map of three levels based on three key columns.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap4l
methods.description: Fetches rows into a nested map of four levels based on four key columns.
